cohort: Postpartum women who were running a minimum of once per week (n=507)
finding: Musculoskeletal pain, stress urinary incontinence, and abdominal separation are prevalent conditions among postpartum runners and are more likely to occur with specific maternal history characteristics, such as musculoskeletal pain during pregnancy, short birth spacing, and vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery decreased the odds of stress urinary incontinence but increased the odds of abdominal separation.
